g.text: Digital Credential Presentation part 0 : verifier setup , once per verifier agency (SD-JWT VC , OpenID4VP 1.0 , Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0)
Verifier Officer
Verifier Officer
Verifier as a Service Portal
Verifier as a Service Portal
VCVP Core
VCVP Core
one-core (Credential Engine)
one-core (Credential Engine)
HSM (AWS KMS)
HSM (AWS KMS)
ETDA Trusted List (CDN)
ETDA Trusted List (CDN)
[SPEC] Verifier Officer = staff of the verifier agency using the Verifier as a Service Portal
sections 0 to 0.3 : the agency sets up once , before any verification request (VP part 1)
0. Verifier Setup (once per verifier agency , not per request)
[SPEC] Verifier organisation , verifier key and verifier DID are prepared in the setup phase , VCVP does not create them during verification
The verifier is registered with ETDA and listed in the Verifier Trusted List (ver.txt) with its public key , allowed claims and purposes
Trusted issuers are decided by the Issuer Trusted List , the verifier does not configure them
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• 12.2.1 G-07 (MAY) verifier key in soft key , TEE / WSCD or HSM
• 12.2.1 (MUST) verifier public key in the Verifier Trusted List entry or a did:web DID document at /.well-known/did.json
[SPEC] the engine verifier DID resolves under a path , so the key is published in the Verifier Trusted List entry | verifier keys in AWS KMS
[STANDARD] OpenID4VP 1.0
• 8.3 the wallet encrypts the response to a key from client_metadata jwks
NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev. 5
• 9.5.3.2 the more copies of a key , the more exposure
[SPEC] the verifier DID has a keyAgreement key in AWS KMS (KEY_AGREEMENT , not exportable) , the engine puts it in client_metadata and decrypts the response
VCVP Core also decrypts the response with it to check the issuer before the engine (VP part 2 , section 7.2) | no copy of the private key
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• 8.1.2 (MUST) create and verify EdDSA and ES256
• 11.2 (MUST) issuers and verifiers accept both
[SPEC] AWS KMS key specs : ECC_NIST_P256 (ES256) , ECC_NIST_EDWARDS25519 (Ed25519 , signing only)
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• 9.8 (MUST) identity , key , status , validity period and scope checked from the Trusted List
• page 12.1 , 12.1.4 (MUST) reject the trust decision when they cannot be confirmed
• page 12.1 , 12.1.6 (MUST NOT) a list without status or scope is not used for real
[PENDING] waiting for ETDA | Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
issue : no fields yet for entity and service status , validity period , VC types of issuers , allowed claims , purposes and wallet type (9.8 , 12.1.4)
question : which fields will list them , and when
[SPEC] decided by ETDA after discussion : these Trusted List fields are phase 2 work , not in phase 1
[WORKAROUND] until ETDA publishes these fields , a missing field does not reject the transaction (12.1.4 MUST reject)
remove when the fields are published (phase 2) , the checks in these diagrams then use them
0.1 Load ETDA Trusted Lists (when a transaction needs them)
[SPEC] steps in the ETDA Trusted List Load sequence (first tab)
VCVP Core also loads ver.txt for its own verifier check in VP part 1 section 2
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• appendix 8.2 E.1.1 (MUST) the verifier fetches iss.txt and wp.txt
[SPEC] Trusted List not usable (TRUST_LIST_EXPIRED / TRUST_LIST_UNAVAILABLE) : the calling step answers 503 Service Unavailable + Retry-After: 300
not the trust failure reason of that step , as in the ETDA Trusted List Load sequence
0.2 Find the published schema of the issuer (schema catalogue of VCVP)
[STANDARD] SD-JWT VC draft-19
• 5.3.2 (MAY) type metadata from a registry the consumer trusts
• 5.3.3 (MAY) an ecosystem defines its own retrieval method
[SPEC] the catalogue lists the schemas that issuers on this VCVP publish (CredentialSchemas , Status = ACTIVE)
schemas of other systems are added to the catalogue manually by agreement
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• 9.8 (MUST) scope of an issuer = VC types and claims it may issue , checked from the Trusted List
[SPEC] decided by ETDA after discussion : the VC types of each issuer in the Trusted List are phase 2 work , the catalogue of VCVP is used
Search the published schemas (issuer , credential type)
List published schemas + Consumer-Key + Token | GET /api/credential-schema/v1/published (VCVP Core 46)
IssuerOrgCode (optional) , CredentialTypeName (optional)
Check Consumer-Key and Token , caller channel , ActorType = OFFICER
validate caller authorization
alt
[Consumer-Key or Token invalid or missing]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 46 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED , OrgCode and Actor empty)
401 + WWW-Authenticate | FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED
Show error , no schemas shown
[Caller not authorized]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 46 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED)
403 | FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
Show error , no schemas shown
[Caller authorized]
Read CredentialSchemas (Status = ACTIVE) of the issuer organisations , filtered by the query , no match gives an empty list
names of the credential type from CredentialTypes , OrgCode and name of the issuer from Organizations
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 46 : who searched the catalogue , with the query
200 | Items [ OrgCode , OrganizationName , CredentialTypeId , NameEn , NameLocal ,
CredentialSchemaId , Formats [ Format , EcosystemSchemaId ] ]
Published schemas of the issuers
Choose one schema to verify (CredentialSchemaId)
0.2.1 Import the published schema of the issuer
[SPEC] VCVPAuditLog for every request , also those rejected at the Consumer-Key check (OrgCode and Actor empty) , kept 7 years
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• 8.6 , 8.8 (MUST) audit log at least 7 years
Import the chosen schema
Import schema + Consumer-Key + Token | POST /api/credential-schema/v1/import (VCVP Core 22)
OrgCode , SourceCredentialSchemaId
Check Consumer-Key and Token , caller channel , ActorType = OFFICER
validate caller authorization
[STANDARD] RFC 9110
• 15.5.2 (MUST) 401 when the request has no valid credentials , with WWW-Authenticate
• 15.5.4 403 when the caller is known but not allowed
alt
[Consumer-Key or Token invalid or missing]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 22 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED , OrgCode and Actor empty)
401 + WWW-Authenticate | FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED
Show error , schema not imported
[Caller not authorized]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 22 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED)
403 | FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
Show error , schema not imported
[Caller authorized]
Map OrgCode to OrganizationId (Organizations)
Get published schema | GET /ssi/schema/v2/{id} (VCVP Core 21)
schema (formats[].ecosystemSchemaId , claims[] key , mappings.technicalKey)
Get the type metadata | GET /ssi/vct/v2/{orgId}/{id}/SD_JWT_VC (VCVP Core 18)
type metadata document
[STANDARD] SD-JWT VC draft-19
• 5.3 (MUST) vct#integrity is an integrity metadata string (section 6)
• 6 hash of the type metadata document
TypeMetadataIntegrity = sha256 of the document octets (sha256-... as in vct#integrity)
Import schema into the verifier organisation | POST /api/credential-schema/v2/import
id
Get imported schema | GET /api/credential-schema/v2/{id}
claims[] with id + key (new claim ids , different from the issuer copy)
[DATA STORE] Store ImportedCredentialSchemas table (Claims[].ClaimId , Source , Formats[].EcosystemSchemaId = vct , Formats[].TypeMetadataIntegrity)
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 22 : who imported which issuer schema (EngineCalls)
200 | ImportedCredentialSchemaId
Schema imported
0.2.2 Read the imported schema (claims to choose)
Open the imported schema to choose the claims to request
Get imported schema claims + Consumer-Key + Token | GET /api/credential-schema/v1/{ImportedCredentialSchemaId} (VCVP Core 45)
Check Consumer-Key and Token , validate caller authorization
Find ImportedCredentialSchemaId in ImportedCredentialSchemas table (Status = ACTIVE) , owned by the caller organisation
alt
[Consumer-Key or Token invalid or missing]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 45 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED , OrgCode and Actor empty)
401 + WWW-Authenticate | FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED
Show error , claims not shown
[Caller organisation not ACTIVE or the schema belongs to another organisation]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 45 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED)
403 | FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
Show error , claims not shown
[Imported schema not found or not ACTIVE]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 45 (FailureReason = SCHEMA_NOT_FOUND)
403 | FailureReason = SCHEMA_NOT_FOUND
Show error , claims not shown
[Schema found]
Get imported schema | GET /api/credential-schema/v2/{id}
schema (claims[] key , datatype , required , translations , mappings)
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 45 : who read which imported schema (EngineCalls)
200 | ImportedCredentialSchemaId , Source , Formats , Claims (Path , NameEn , NameLocal , Type , Required)
Claims that can be requested
0.3 Define what to request (verification template)
Define verification template (claims to request , chosen from the result of VCVP Core 45)
Create verification template + Consumer-Key + Token | POST /api/proof-schema/v1 (VCVP Core 23)
Inputs [ ImportedCredentialSchemaId , Claims ex : LicenseNumber , FullNameTH ]
Check Consumer-Key and Token , validate caller authorization
alt
[Consumer-Key or Token invalid or missing]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 23 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED , OrgCode and Actor empty)
401 + WWW-Authenticate | FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED
Show error , template not created
[Caller not authorized]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 23 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED)
403 | FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
Show error , template not created
[Caller authorized]
Find ImportedCredentialSchemaId in ImportedCredentialSchemas table (Status = ACTIVE) , owned by the caller organisation
not found 403 FailureReason = SCHEMA_NOT_FOUND , another organisation 403 FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
Check the requested claims exist in Claims[].Path of that schema , otherwise 400 FailureReason = REQUEST_REJECTED
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• 7.2 item 3 the wallet enforces the purposes and allowed claims of the verifier
• appendix 8.2 E.1.5 (MUST) claims path and purpose within the scope allowed for the verifier , otherwise rejected
[SPEC] decided by ETDA after discussion : checking the requested claims against ver.txt is phase 2 work , not done in phase 1
Check the requested claims are within the claims allowed for this verifier in the Verifier Trusted List (ver.txt)
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• 7.7 item 3 (MUST) check the schema version , not the type name only
[SPEC] the vct contains the schema id , a new schema version is a new schema with a new vct and new type metadata
the vct and vct#integrity of the presented credential are checked in VP part 2 , section 7.2
[ENGINE RULE] expireDuration is how long the engine keeps the received claim values after the check
(retainUntilDate = completedDate + expireDuration , then the engine deletes them)
It is not the lifetime of the verification link (the link lives 1 hour)
[STANDARD] RFC 9901 (SD-JWT)
• 10.2 (SHOULD NOT) after verification the verifier does not store the issuer-signed JWT or the disclosures
[SPEC] claim values stay in the engine until the portal reads the result , at most 3600 seconds (expireDuration)
Define verification requirements | POST /api/proof-schema/v1
proofInputSchemas [ credentialSchemaId , claimSchemas [ id , required ] ] , expireDuration
id
[DATA STORE] Store VerificationTemplates table (VerificationTemplateId = id from the engine)
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 23 : who created which verification template (EngineCalls)
200 | VerificationTemplateId
Verification template ready
